title: SB2611 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 38 and Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2026-02-02; own version, official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260513162326 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/114/Bill/SB2611.pdf; the last listed version was not archived)
provenance.note: Draft dated 2026-02-02 (as filed). The 39-17-1351 quote of subsection (a) is split at a page footer. The last listed version was not archived; later amendments are not in the text read. Subsection (b) requires 40 hours initial and 8 hours annual POST-certified training.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (new section in TCA Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13): (a) A current or former chancery, circuit, or appellate court judge, who is an enhanced handgun carry permit holder, pursuant to § 39-17-1351, and has completed
SECTION 1 (continuing, new section in TCA Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13): the training required in subsection (b) is authorized to carry a firearm in the same manner and locations that a law enforcement officer may carry a firearm under § 39-17- 1350.
SECTION 1 (new section in TCA Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13): (c) The administrative office of the courts shall develop a uniform identification system clearly identifying that a judge is qualified under this section to carry a firearm. A judge authorized to carry a firearm under this section shall carry the identification at all times the judge is carrying a firearm.
